title: Case 049: Duplicate delivery service charge appears on a business invoice

details.source_role: Vera Senn, Mossline Press finance coordinator
details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: Two invoice lines have the same shipment, service and date. The authorised billing team must confirm duplication and issue a credit note and revised balance.
initial_request: Please ask billing to review the duplicate before we pay this invoice. We have not paid either line.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier's authorised billing team to review the two matching charge lines.

outcome: Billing issues a credit note for the confirmed duplicate and the revised invoice reconciles.
boundaries: A credit note is an accounting adjustment, not cash received. GBP 36.00 minus GBP 18.00 equals GBP 18.00 due.

events.from: Vera Senn, Mossline Press finance coordinator
events.body: Inline invoice INV-049: line 1 delivery service DL-049, 2026-03-22, GBP 18.00; line 2 delivery service DL-049, 2026-03-22, GBP 18.00; invoice total GBP 36.00. Both lines have the same service key. No separate service is listed.

events.from: Vera Senn, Mossline Press finance coordinator
events.body: Please ask billing to review the duplicate before we pay this invoice. We have not paid either line.
Please review INV-049’s two GBP 18.00 lines for the same DL-049 delivery service and date. If duplication is confirmed, issue the authorised credit and revised invoice balance.

Duplicate confirmed: line 2 repeats line 1, not a second service. [Credit and revised statement](attachments/credit-statement.pdf): CN-049 credits GBP 18.00 against INV-049; revised amount due GBP 18.00. No money has been refunded because nothing was paid.

attachments.name: credit-statement.pdf
attachments.text:
SYNTHETIC EXERCISE - NOT A LIVE DOCUMENT


Credit CN-049 and revised statement

Issued: 2026-03-22 09:50 UTC



Issuer: Plover Arc Logistics - Business billing



Customer: Mossline Press | Invoice: INV-049 | Shipment: DL-049



Original line 1: delivery service, 2026-03-22, GBP 18.00



Original line 2: duplicate of line 1, GBP 18.00 | Original total: GBP 36.00



Credit note CN-049: GBP 18.00 against duplicate line 2.



Revised amount due: GBP 18.00 (36.00 - 18.00). Nothing has been paid.



Accounting credit only; no cash refund or bank transfer has occurred.
